text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests run, all OK. I changed only files in `catalog/` and didn't touch the tests.

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`. This fixed both the year check and `age()`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is 5 instead of 3, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. It was importing from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee is now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`. It was adding the two.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` slices `[-n:]` instead of `[-n - 1:]`, which returned one event too many.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` now includes a third book, `Emma`. I chose the author (Austen), year (1815) and copy count (1) myself, copying the `Emma` record in `tests/test_search.py`. The tests only check the title and the count, so change them if you want different details.
